defects.description: Description: Recline on one elbow with both knees tucked toward the SAME SIDE, creating a soft spiral. Current config has NO globalRoll set (defaults 0). Body is prone-leaning (globalTilt=60) with no side roll — NOT reclining on side with elbow prop. Need globalRoll ±45 for side-lying with elbow prop.

Description: both knees tucked toward the SAME SIDE (asymmetric, spiral). Current leftHip=rightHip=60 (symmetric), leftKnee=rightKnee=50 (symmetric), no hipAbduct set. Knees at x=±0.13 (symmetric, NOT to same side). Need asymmetric hip flexion + hipAbduct to bring both knees to one side.

Description: recline on ONE ELBOW (one elbow propping torso). Current pose has no shoulderFwd set, both elbows at y=0.21/0.18 (above floor y=0.05 hips). Neither elbow is propping on floor. Need shoulderFwd to swing one arm down to floor for elbow prop.

Description: rest the FREE ARM along the thigh. Current arms are symmetric (leftShoulder=-20, rightShoulder=-8, both elbows moderately bent). Neither arm distinctly rests along thigh. The non-prop arm should be straighter, draped along thigh.

failing_tests: description says recline on one elbow but no globalRoll and no shoulderFwd for elbow prop
description says knees tucked toward same side but knees symmetric
description says free arm along thigh but arms symmetric
regression_risk: high — 10-field rework to convert partial-prone symmetric pose to side-lying twist with elbow prop + asymmetric knees. Rig-limited: no isolated torso twist joint (globalTwist rotates entire body), no hip-origin-y control (elbow cannot truly prop on floor from elevated torso). Approximation only. Re-render verify REQUIRED.
rationale: Description: Recline on one elbow with both knees tucked toward the same side, creating a soft spiral through the lower body. Rest the free arm along the thigh, eyes heavy-lidded. Current pose is partial-prone (globalTilt=60) with symmetric legs/arms — does NOT match description. Per protocol §4 use description. Fix: (1) globalRoll 0→-45 (body rolls onto LEFT side for side-lying). (2) One elbow prop: shoulderFwdL 0→+30 (LEFT arm swings BEHIND body per corrected convention + = behind; in side-lying body-behind maps mostly DOWN, LEFT elbow becomes prop on floor). LEFT arm is bottom-side, becomes the prop. (3) Knees to same side (LEFT): hipAbductL 0→-20 (LEFT knee outward to LEFT = ABDUCTION per corrected convention - = outward), hipAbductR 0→+20 (RIGHT knee inward to LEFT = ADDUCTION per corrected convention + = inward). Both knees biased to LEFT side. (4) Asymmetric hip flexion: leftHip 60→30 (LEFT/bottom knee less flexed), rightHip 60→90 (RIGHT/top knee more flexed, tucked up). (5) Free arm along thigh: rightShoulder -8→+8 (RIGHT arm at side, less raised), rightElbow 45→18 (RIGHT arm extended along thigh, less bent). (6) spine -8→5 (slight forward lean onto elbow). (7) neck 3→0 (neutral, eyes heavy-lidded implies head level). LEFT elbow prop is rig-limited (elbow cannot truly reach floor from elevated torso). Knees-to-same-side is rig-limited (no isolated leg cross joint, approximation via hipAbduct).
